> The AI-native email platform for newsletters, automations, and transactional email.

Lumail lets teams and AI agents create campaigns, manage subscribers, automate email workflows, send transactional messages, and inspect delivery analytics from one organization-scoped platform. - [MCP server](https://lumail.io/mcp): Streamable HTTP endpoint protected by OAuth 2.1 or organization API tokens.

- [Agent documentation index](https://lumail.io/llms.txt): concise markdown index of every agent and developer resource.
- [Full markdown documentation](https://lumail.io/llms-full.txt): concatenated public documentation for offline retrieval.

## Developer access

- [REST API reference](https://lumail.io/docs/api-reference.md): subscriber, tag, event, campaign, and transactional-email operations.

- [MCP reference](https://lumail.io/docs/api-reference/mcp.md): transports, authentication, tools, resources, and limits.
